_comment: Homepage tools registry. The homepage renders tools with status 'live' in the featured (illuminated) section and status 'coming_soon' in the dimmer (unlit) section. Flip a status to 'live' to promote a tool automatically, no markup changes required. Frequency numbers are invented but consistent with the tuning-dial concept.

tools.name: Random Song Generator
tools.blurb: Hit generate and let the decade pick a track for you, from any of the eight genres, playing right on the page.

tools.name: Party Playlist Builder
tools.blurb: Pick a vibe such as upbeat, romantic or dance, and build a shuffled playlist to match the mood.

tools.name: Music Trivia
tools.blurb: A ten-question round drawn from real facts about the decade's greatest records. Keep score, then play again.

tools.name: What's Your 60s Sound?
tools.blurb: Answer seven quick questions and discover which 1960s genre is your personal soundtrack.

tools.name: Radio Dial
tools.blurb: A continuous, station-style listening experience that rotates through each genre.

tools.name: Daily Guessing Game
tools.blurb: A new song clip every day: guess the track from a short, recognizable hook.

tools.name: 60s Crossword
tools.blurb: A 1960s-themed crossword built from the artists, songs and stories of the decade.
